## SerializedPermissionDeniedAuditRecord interface

The JSON-serializable form of a [PermissionDeniedAuditRecord](./core.permissiondeniedauditrecord.md)<!-- -->: its attribution and the time as an ISO-8601 string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface SerializedPermissionDeniedAuditRecord extends AuditRecordBase
```

**Extends:** [AuditRecordBase](./core.auditrecordbase.md)
